comparison.objective: Check a two-pole voltage tester on a proving unit before and after testing two terminals, stopping if it shows nothing.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequence probe contacts and interpret tester indications, rather than stabilize and strike a mechanical break-off mandrel.
comparison.success_condition: Both proving checks and terminal tests must follow the safety sequence, with stopping on no indication; indication thresholds and scoring details are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests electrical verification and conditional safety behavior, not force-controlled fracture, insert retention, or fragment recovery.
